companyFieldUpdates.description: Cleco Corporate Holdings LLC is the operating parent within the privately held Cleco Group utility platform, serving Louisiana through Cleco Power and related generation assets. The regulated utility serves approximately 298,000 customers across 24 Louisiana parishes and owns eight generating units with 2,676 MW of rated capacity, supported by transmission and distribution networks and approved tariffs. Macquarie Asset Management, BCI and Manulife completed the take-private acquisition on April 13, 2016 and remain the legal owners; their last publicly confirmed 2020 interests were 53.9%, 36.9% and 9.2%, respectively, while exact current percentages are not publicly disclosed. A signed agreement announced April 27, 2026 would sell 100% of Cleco Group to Pine JV Holdings LLC, backed by Stonepeak and Bernhard Capital Partners, but the regulatory proceedings remained open through August 19, 2026, so the existing owners remain active pending closing.
